newsitem.title: KENYA: U.S. warns citizens to avoid Kenya coast.
newsitem.headline: U.S. warns citizens to avoid Kenya coast.

text.p: The U.S. government has warned its citizens to avoid travel to Kenya's Indian Ocean coast after more than 30 people were killed in a string of attacks.
"The Department of State recommends that American citizens avoid travel to the coastal province of Kenya including the city of Mombasa and its suburbs," said a statement released on Monday.

"Residents and visitors in the Mombasa area are urged to take the highest security precautions. Travel to Mombasa and the surrounding areas should be avoided until the situation has stabilised," it said.

A total of 37 people have been killed in seven days of violence on Kenya's coast, a centre of its tourism industry. More than 100 curio stalls were set ablaze overnight at Malindi north of Mombasa in the first attack on a tourist site.
Police blamed arsonists for the Malindi attack and said no one was hurt.
